misconfig_patterns: No auth in default deployment — all /v1/* endpoints open
GET /v1/models returns model list including model path on disk
POST /v1/embeddings open — embedding oracle without key
INFINITY_API_KEY not required by default; must be explicitly set

active_probe.false_positive_check: OpenAPI title must be 'Infinity Emb' — uniquely identifies michaelfeil/infinity, not InfiniFlow vector DB (port 23820) or generic infinity string

deployment_tells: Shodan-dark — port 7997 is the default but rarely HTTP-crawled; JSON root not HTML
OpenAI-compatible API: /v1/embeddings accepts {model, input} same as OpenAI spec
Supports reranking (/v1/rerank) and classification (/v1/classify) alongside embeddings
Often used as drop-in OpenAI embedding replacement in LlamaIndex and LangChain pipelines
NOTE: completely different from InfiniFlow/Infinity (port 23820, vector database) — name collision
pivot_paths: GET /v1/models → model list → identifies HuggingFace model paths (BAAI/bge-*, nomic-embed-*)
GET /openapi.json → routes + schemas → confirm endpoint set
